persons.name: Bhūpatīndramalla
persons.evidence: śrīśrījaya bhūpatīndramalladevasana cuka(6)cāsa devapratiṣṭhā siddhāgni ayutāhuti yajña yāṅāyā thva (7) saṃphuli

date.as_written: saṃ 825 bhādrapada śukla daśamī mūla śanīścaravārakuhnu

purpose: devapratiṣṭhā siddhāgni ayutāhuti yajña yāṅāyā thva saṃphuli
notes: The manuscript is a manual/record book (saṃphuli) prepared for/during the Devapratiṣṭhā and Ayutāhuti yajña performed by King Bhūpatīndra Malla in the Cukacā (courtyard in the royal palace complex of Bhaktapur).
